description:
## What

Extract §6.1.5(a)+(b) leaf finalisation + §6.1.5(g) intersect-tree-with-user-initial-policy-set (lines 2669–2828) into `pub(crate) fn finalise_policy_tree_with_user_set(state: &mut WorkingState, policy: &ValidationPolicy) -> Result<()>`.

## Risk

HIGH. Largest single helper; final state-machine resolution.

## §6.1.5(a) decrement-skip optimisation (PKIX-als9 design §7)

> "§6.1.5(a) skips the RFC-mandated decrements of inhibit_any and policy_mapping with comment neither is read after §6.1.5(a) (lines 2683–2685). Static-analysis claim, not tested invariant. If H11 extracted, comment must move with it; if any future code reads those after H11, the optimisation becomes a bug."

The comment must move WITH the code into H11 and be made even more explicit at the helper boundary.

## PKITS coverage gap (design §5)

> "8-way `initial_*` flag matrix in §6.1.5(g) — partial coverage; H11 is where this would bite."

## Dependencies

- H10 (sequenced).

## Acceptance

- New helper.
- Comment about §6.1.5(a) decrement skip moved with the code, with explicit warning at helper boundary.
- PKITS tests for `initial_explicit_policy`, `initial_policy_mapping_inhibit`, `initial_any_policy_inhibit` pass.
- §4.5, §4.8–§4.12 all pass.
- clippy clean.
- No behaviour change.
title: als9: H11 — extract finalise_policy_tree_with_user_set (~160 lines, §6.1.5(a)+(b)+(g))
